subject: integration
name: Orivon's IPFS node
summary: The IPFS node Orivon runs on this computer (WebAssembly, in a process of its own) and the default source of ipfs:// content. Open source. Every block it receives is checked against its CID, so a peer or a pinning service can slow a load and never change what a site is. It finds who holds a block through the IPFS network and, when the person allows it, two lookup services. Not private: peers see this computer's address and what it asks for, unless the tunnel for nodes is on. Judged here by its publisher.
